implementation.predicate: Retain the second attempt numerical plan: fuse complete numeric/finite/nonnegative validation with ordered row and first-column accumulation using the original f64 Sum negative-zero identity. After full valid input, return true for all row sums equal to 1.0, or false if the first column fails. A single passing column is complete; with one row, remaining single-cell columns compare directly to 1.0. Otherwise traverse row-major cells and accumulate only the remaining columns in original row order, then compare each exactly to 1.0. Matrix traversal flattens borrowed contiguous slices so a slice iterator walks each page without locating every cell.
implementation.resources: A private ArrayValues slices iterator borrows small storage or existing paged Arc<Vec> slices without Arc cloning, heap allocation or persistent storage fields; existing ArrayIter consumers remain unchanged. No public ABI/schema, Pine matrix rule, host dependency or cache policy added. Row-success, invalid-input, first-column-failure and single-axis paths need no numeric scratch allocation; the remaining-column path allocates (columns - 1) * sizeof(f64), without copying all cells or repeated random paged column indexing. It may perform additions for later columns even when an earlier remaining column eventually fails; original column all could stop before those later columns. Pure reads/additions preserve the result, and actual allocations/performance are measured.
implementation.regressions: Four independent old-copy-buffer private tests plus four public API tests cover both rectangular orientations, numeric kinds, every non-convertible raw PineValue kind, invalid/negative/nonfinite/NA values, empty dimensions, signed zero, rounding-sensitive reduction order, page boundaries and snapshots. Borrowed slice traversal additionally checks original variants, recursive Float bits, pointer identity, exact logical length and repeated exhaustion; paged shrink from 257 through 129/128/127/1/0 and regrowth retains original snapshots. Public tests cover v5/v6, fill/set/copy/var history, repeated same-site predicates after argument mutations, forming replacements, errors after predicate evaluation, complete output/profile/revision/last_changes atomic rollback, confirmation and future commits.

mapReadOnlyConstraints.proposal: After every key/value eval_expr completes, obtain one opaque private hash/slot result for that operation and reuse it for capacity/pressure and mutation. Charge pressure before get_mut/COW exactly as before. Preserve existing key validity, overwrites, insertion order and signed-zero key identity; no cross-expression cache.
mapReadOnlyConstraints.hazards: Argument evaluation can mutate the target map. GC is deferred to bar boundaries but pressure accounting must stay unchanged. Float hashing canonicalizes +/-0 while overwrite retains the original key bits. Collision buckets need key equality; tombstone compaction changes logical slots. put_all preflights all distinct absent keys before any write and needs separate design. No Map production change or performance evidence in this wave.
